title: dublin-grown arg-count guard prints usage() but never exits — the verb proceeds with malformed args
detail: usage() only prints (no exit), so with >2 args the harness emits the usage error then runs the capture anyway, silently consuming rest[0]/rest[1] and ignoring extras — inconsistent with the same block's fail-fast os.exit(2) on bad ms.
recommended_fix: Add os.exit(2) after usage() in the arg-count guard, matching the bad-ms path.

title: no empty-districts guard: map_board_partition traps and map_district_assign defaults to 0 on a district-less board
detail: With zero districts and a non-empty pool, map_district_assign returns the default 0 and partition appends to district_tiles[0] on an empty outer array (out-of-bounds at load). The loader guards empty candidates; no districts guard is visible in this diff.
recommended_fix: Fail the load for a candidates-bearing board with zero districts (mirror the empty-pool check), or guard partition/assign.
